1. (Currently Amended) A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, __wherein the agent is formulated for administration to a subject with diagnosed glaucoma or at risk for glaucoma based on clinical examination__.

2. (Currently Amended) A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, __wherein the agent is formulated for administration to a subject with diagnosed ocular hypertension or at risk for ocular hypertension based on clinical examination__.

3. (Currently Amended) A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier, __wherein the composition is formulated for treatment of glaucoma or ocular hypertension in a subject with diagnosed disease or clinical risk factors__.

7. (Currently Amended) A method for treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered __to a subject diagnosed with glaucoma__.

8. (Currently Amended) A method for treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered __to a subject diagnosed with ocular hypertension__.

9. (Previously Presented) A method for treating glaucoma comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

10. (Previously Presented) A method for treating ocular hypertention comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

11. (Currently Amended) A method for enhancing an intraocular pressure-reducing action of (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or its salt in a subject with glaucoma or ocular hypertension, wherein phosphoric acid or a salt thereof is combined with (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof.

12. (Cancelled)
